description: Canonical structured storyboard contract between PDF/storyboard parsing and downstream SourceSceneIR or storyboard2html generation. This IR preserves storyboard semantics without requiring downstream prompts to infer interactions from prose.
normalizationRules: Frames may come from frames, storyboardFrames, storyboard.frames, or blueprint storyboard fields.
Character and scene sheets are preserved as structured dictionaries when present.
Colon actions such as collect:Corn:3 map to interaction.verb/resource/amount deterministically.
Chinese and English action prose is normalized to a finite interaction verb set.
Entity names, ids, labels, and chineseName aliases are used as deterministic target candidates.
Joystick and drag interactions are marked in riskHints for CUA/runtime hard-gate planning.

downstreamPolicy.storyboard2html: Input bundles should include storyboardIr while retaining legacy storyboardFrames during migration.
downstreamPolicy.sourceSceneIr: Future compilers should derive SourceSceneIR phases, entities, resources, and runtimeContract from storyboardIr plus deterministic defaults before falling back to LLM.
downstreamPolicy.llmHotPath: LLM usage should be limited to filling missing visual/entity metadata or resolving ambiguous diagnostics, not parsing every frame on the hot path.
